notes: 10 hour fishing excursion great for both novice and experienced fishermen, these 10 hour deep-sea fishing trips fish legendary catalina island or over 80 miles of coastal waters for over 2 dozen different species of game fish. we offer limited load 3/4 day to full day fishing trips that are available for anyone wanting the full day experience without having a crowded boat. these trips give you ample fishing time and elbow room. you do not need to be an experienced fisherman to successfully catch fish. with experienced crew always nearby, any questions or help with rigging is immediately taken care of. trips catching hundreds of fish are quite common and trophy sized fish from several species are available year round. some species of fish that we encounter include halibut, yellowtail, sand bass and calico bass, barracuda, bonito, tuna, rockfish, giant sheephead, and dozens of other species. fish cleaning services are available onboard for a small fee and catch and release is also an option for those not wanting to take fish. from novice to the experienced angler, pierpoint landing is the fishing destination for you. outside alcohol, ice chests, coolers, or glass containers are strictly prohibited. vessel subject to change. ca department of fish & wildlife fishing licenses available for purchase at pierpoint landing. licenses are required for anyone 16 years of age and older. fish cleaning, gratuity, and galley, and any other on boat purchases are all cash only and are not included in ticket price. full galley is available rental rod $17.64 1-day license $21.09 annual license $71.84 (everyone 16 or older is required by law to have license) $3 parking available in office, spots 1-29 only after 1-29 is full we have additional parking in our overflow lot
